subject_invite: Share your ONGC journey: Smriti knowledge legacy programme

auto-2m.label: Two-month invitation
auto-2m.subject: Share your journey with the next generation: Smriti knowledge legacy programme
auto-2m.body:
Dear {{name}},

Your superannuation date is {{dor}} ({{days}} days from today). Thank you for your many years of service to the organisation.

We would like your experience, judgement and stories to guide those who follow. Please log in to the Smriti portal and tell us how you would like to share them: a written questionnaire, a recorded interview, or both.

Portal: {{link}}

It takes about 30 minutes to begin, and you can save your progress and return any time.

With regards,
Knowledge Management Team
